question: In a certain code language,‘GHOST’ is written as ‘JCRNW’ and ‘FIRED’ is written as ‘IDUZG’. How will ‘RIFLE’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'GHOST’ is written as ‘JCRNW',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3aeb9762abbcf1a94e6620b3a9ab17fc113e6d6767eebf7fd8ec04094bd612cf.png] 

For, 'FIRED’ is written as ‘IDUZG',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a4bec3a7ef7acc4af630f808c8e7a60a563daeee090b145117ee038c94a7600.png] 

Similarly, for '**RIFLE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e05a9bdc930746c97713c7f97711067de1b36605b60dacdd0bf60afb6d71dda.png] 

So, '**RIFLE**' is coded as '**UDIGH**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
